PRUNED.txt: cell 5 screencast frames removed from this directory on 2026-10-10, before the folder was committed (repository size).
Rule per sequence (shots/<load>/): keep every NNN-<ms>ms.jpg with ms <= 400 (plain loads) or <= 2500 (throttled loads), every 10th frame
(index 0, 10, 20, ...) after that, the last frame, and every frame whose file name appears in a text file of this directory; final.png is kept.
The page-load record that remains is flash-loads.jsonl and flash-summary.txt/.json (DOM record and painted-frame record, in ms from navigation);
they do not list the screencast frames, so the deleted frames are known only by the names below (the number in a name is its ms).
